NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, that the City of the Hawaiian Gardens Recreation and Parks Commission
is hereby called to be held on Tuesday, October 13, 2026, beginning at 6:00 p.m., at the City Council
Chambers, 21815 Pioneer Blvd., Hawaiian Gardens, CA 90716.

Please note: The City of Hawaiian Gardens complies with the provisions of the Americans with
Disabilities Act (ADA). Anyone needing special assistance please contact the City Clerk's Department at
(562) 420-2641, at least one (1) business day prior to the meeting so that we may accommodate you.

SUBJECT:  PRESENTATION OF THE RECREATION AND PARKS COMMISSION

SUMMARY

Presentation of the Recreation and Parks Commission Meeting Minutes for the
Commission's review and approval.

RECOMMENDATION

Approve the Recreation and Parks Commission Meeting Minutes as presented for
September 2026.

ATTACHMENTS

Recreation and Parks Commission Meeting Minutes for the month of September 2026.
   MINUTES
  CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS
  RECREATION AND PARKS COMMISSION
  SEPTEMBER 8, 2026

The Regular Meeting of the Hawaiian Gardens Recreation and Parks Commission is hereby called to
order on Tuesday, September 8, 2026, at 6:02 p.m., at the City Council Chambers, 21815 Pioneer
Blvd., Hawaiian Gardens, CA 90716.

The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Chair Amaro.

ROLL CALL
PRESENT
  Chairmember  Pedro Amaro
  Vice Chair  Luis Gonzalez
  Commissioner  Carmen Hernandez
  Commissioner  Ariana Chavez

ABSENT
  Commissioner Anna Rodriguez

Chair Amaro made a motion to excuse Commissioner Rodriguez. Vice Chair Gonzalez second the
motion.

Also in attendance: Recreation Director, Joseph Jimenez; Recreation Coordinator, Anthony
Dominguez and Recording Secretary, Elizabeth Vigil.

PUBLIC COMMENTS - ITEMS ON AND OFF THE AGENDA

No Public Comments

  A. CONSENT CALENDAR

  1. Presentation of the Recreation and Parks Commission Meeting Minutes for the month of
  August 2026
  Commission Action: Receive and File

  2. Department Monthly Report
  Commission Action: Receive and File

  3. Promotional Materials
  Commission Action: Receive and File

  Chair Amaro made a motion to receive and file Consent Calendar, Commissioner
  Hernandez second the motion.

  Page I of2
Recreation and Parks Commission
Regular Meeting Minutes
September 8, 2026
   B. DISCUSSION ITEMS

  1. Teen Center Update Presentation

  The Teen Center staff showcased a slideshow that highlighted upcoming events, program
  goals, and the reestablishment of the Teen Council. The Teen Center acts as the primary
  hub for the YAL Program as well as STEM activities.

  2. Summer Recap Video

  The staff delivered an overview slide presentation that highlighted the Recreation Summer
  programming.

  3. Special Events Update

  Staff shared the following upcoming special events:

  • Summer Concerts & Graduation Banner Distribution
  September 18th I CRL Center 17 PM - 9 PM

  • Golf Tournament
  Old Ranch Country Club I October 12th I 8:30 AM - 3:30 PM

  • Red Ribbon Walk & Rally
  October 28th I CRL Gym I 6 PM - 8 PM

  • Halloween Program
  October 31st I CRL Center I 6 PM - 8 PM

  • Veterans Day Ceremony
  November 6th I CRL Center I 6 PM

  C. ORAL COMMISIONERS REPORT

  Commissioner Hernandez currently has no updates to report.

  Vice Chair Gonzalez inquired on the Summer Food Service Program and the number of
  participants.

  Commissioner Chavez expressed gratitude to the Recreation staff for providing a variety of
  program options throughout the summer.

  Chair Amaro extended thanks to the Teen Center staff for their program presentation and
  appreciated the Recreation staff for their excellent work during the summer.

  ADJOURNMENT to the next regular Recreation and Parks Commission Meeting on October
  13, 2026, at 6:00p.m.
